# N14 auxiliary iid: exact 58th optimal affine segment

**2026-10-24 | AUTHOR-LEVEL EXACT FINITE-MODEL PROOF | Not independently Research Driver reviewed.**

## Model, inherited boundary and provenance

Under the iid symbol laws P=(1/8,1/24,5/6), Q=(1/12,1/12,5/6), horizon N=14, allow arbitrary ordered-history-dependent randomized stopping and decisions. Let eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP and tQ be expected sample counts, and V14(alpha)=inf{max(tP,tQ):eP,eQ<=alpha}. This auxiliary model is not proved equivalent to native BRC, X6 or Heartbeat.

Frozen global source: awdawmip/chatgpt-global-knowledge@2d3d634a004979f7263e09a54eba5db2bc3eed80; P000 projection matches original blob. Initial EM source: awdawmip/enterprise-math@f08938461d73792f626c949c20044cbdac50dc8a. The prior author-checked 57th endpoint is alpha57=1292959785652284215/3725075438477770752, V57=24710969410964542757/1862537719238885376, s57=6490130652840539/10444800000000000 at B=(12,0,1). Its exact historical stop sets are carried in the portable checker, with A57=(8,5,0) now fixed to immediate P.

## Statement: all REAL delta in a closed interval

Let K58=11042892/1007, lambdaQ=K58, lambdaP=72+(8/9)K58=9888408/1007, Gamma58=lambdaP+lambdaQ=20931300/1007, and eta58=10447625/3233572429234176.

For every real 0<=delta<=eta58,

    V14(alpha57+delta)=V57-Gamma58*delta.

The exact new endpoint is

    alpha58=1292959797687948215/3725075438477770752,
    V58=24710844325515742757/1862537719238885376.

The dual supporting line is sharp at this right endpoint; this is not an endpoint of the domain of V14.

## Bellman lower bound

At count state (n,a,b), the conditional iid likelihood ratio is L=Q(h)/P(h)=2^(a+b)/3^a, constant across its ordered histories. Define P-measure Bellman D(x) as the minimum of costs lambdaQ*L (decide P), lambdaP (decide Q), 1+sum_i P_i D(child_i) (continue when n<14). Backward minimization on the full history tree reduces to these 680 count states because both L and the future iid distribution factor through the counts; no restriction to Markov or deterministic policies is imposed. Exactly 1240 nonselected comparisons yield 1238 positive gaps, zero negative gaps, and precisely two ties: C/P at A58=(10,6,1), C/Q at B=(12,0,1). The exact root value

    D(root)=797444030994627622898297/110327969604326916096
           =V57+Gamma58*alpha57.

For any policy, D(root)<=tP+lambdaP*eP+lambdaQ*eQ<=max(tP,tQ)+Gamma58*alpha. This proves the claimed affine lower bound for all randomized history policies.

## First arrivals, continuation risks and attainable matching strategy

At A58=(10,6,1) there are 840 nominal ordered words but 176 have already stopped under the actual inherited tree; only 664 arrive alive. Their exact P/Q masses are pA=10375/169869312 and qA=10375/967458816. At B=(12,0,1), all 12 nominal words first arrive, with pB=48828125/725594112 and qB=48828125/362797056. The continuation conditional quadruples (eP,eQ,tP,tQ) are

    cA=(67/331776,6901/6912,14947/13824,75/64),
    cB=(63/64,1/144,9/8,13/12).

A58 and B first-arrival cylinders cannot overlap: A58 has a=6, B has a=0, and a can only increase. Earlier stopping at A57 IS accounted for in the 664 first hits at A58.

Take immediate P at A58 with probability u, immediate Q at B with probability s. The changes from the 57th endpoint are exactly

    eP-alpha57=-X*u+E*(s-s57),
    eQ-alpha57= Y*u-H*(s-s57),

where

    X=pA*cA.eP=695125/56358560858112,
    Y=qA*(1-cA.eQ)=114125/6687075336192,
    E=pB*(1-cB.eP)=48828125/46438023168,
    H=qB*cB.eQ=48828125/52242776064.

Balance both errors with s=s57+h58*u and

    h58=(X+Y)/(E+H)=3221147/217600000000,
    eta58=-X+E*h58=Y-H*h58=10447625/3233572429234176.

Then for every real u in [0,1], eP=eQ=alpha57+eta58*u, s belongs to [s57,s58] with s58=6490285267896539/10444800000000000<1. Exact forward absorption yields tP=V57-Gamma58*eta58*u and

    (tP-tQ) at u=0 =327620777400053281/620845906412961792 > 0,
    (tP-tQ) at u=1 =327588224513205281/620845906412961792 > 0.

Because the tie cylinders are disjoint, risks are affine in u along this line; hence tP>=tQ everywhere. The lower bound is attained throughout the full real interval.

## Sharpness

Finite-horizon policy occupation measures are a compact polytope. If this same dual line remained optimal to the right, its strictly positive multipliers would force eP=eQ=alpha and equality in every Bellman inequality at reached histories. Only A58 and B are tied. Any history-specific action probabilities at these count states reduce to mass-weighted effective u,s in [0,1], as continuation risks are equal on histories with the same counts. Balance forces s=s57+h58*u and alpha=alpha57+eta58*u<=alpha58, contradiction. Thus this particular supporting line ceases to be optimal strictly to the right.

## Verification, limits, next

A Python-stdlib exact-Fraction primary checker verifies 680 states, 1240 slacks, first-hit masses, suffix risks and seven rational mixtures. A second author-side checker enumerates all nominal ordered words at A58, recomputes the Bellman minimum and four-corner backward risk, and confirms seven mixtures. The two scripts share previous stop sets; neither is an independent Driver nor formal proof assistant. The real-interval statement follows mathematically from the verified rational coefficients and affine structure, not from checking just seven rational samples. All claims are confined to the auxiliary iid model.

Next *unproved dual crossing candidate*: K59=57829359672/5658763 at A59=(6,1,3), C/Q. First-hit masses under the 58th tree, compensation and the 59th interval remain to be proved. Native active owner and formal CLAIM were not verified: the attempted direct backend connection reported BACKEND_IDENTITY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE with operation_sent=false.
